name: Kõpu Lighthouse
description: One of the oldest working lighthouses in the world, up since 1531, a white stone tower standing on the highest hill on Hiiumaa. You climb the inside on a narrow stair and come out at 102m above the sea with nothing but forest in every direction.
getting: Ferry from Rohuküla to Heltermaa, 90 minutes, cars carried. Then 50km across the island. Book the ferry ahead in July.
